land.text: the Saruhan lands, absorbed 'as a province' after Mehmed I killed the last ruler

successors.note: First overrun by Bayezid I in 1390, restored (ruler table Orhan Bey 1402-1404), finally absorbed in 1412 on the Sarukhanids page; the Manisa page says Manisa 'became part of the Ottoman Empire in 1410'; Cliopatria's Ottoman shape takes Manisa in 1415. The region stayed an Ottoman sanjak called Sarukhan.

region.text: Manisa and the Hermus valley round it

ledger.note: 1313: Saruhan Bey takes Manisa and founds the Saruhan beylik there. 'Manisa fell to the Beylik of Saruhan in 1313.' The Sarukhanids page says it 'was founded by the tribal chief Saruhan about 1300' and starts the ruler list in 1313; the region is Cliopatria's 1314 shape round the capital and the towns the page names.

1390: Bayezid I overruns Saruhan. The dynasty 'lasted for a first time until 1390, when Bayezid I overran the region'; the ruler list reads 'Under Ottoman rule (1390-1402)'. The Manisa page agrees: 'His sons held the region until 1390.'

1402: the beylik is restored under Orhan Bey. The ruler list resumes with 'Orhan Bey (1402-1404)' after the Ottoman years; the page does not say who restored it or how (the Battle of Ankara page dates the battle to 28 July 1402).

1412: Mehmed I ends Saruhan. 'finally until 1412, when the Ottoman Sultan Mehmed I killed Hızır, the last Saruhan ruler' and absorbed the beylik as a province. The Manisa page has Manisa Ottoman in 1410 and the ruler list gives Orhan Bey 1410-1412, so the year is the text's and the sources differ by two years.
1412: the Saruhan beylik ends; its land becomes the Ottoman sanjak of Sarukhan 'until the early years of the Republic of Turkey'.

wars.name: Bayezid I's overrunning of Saruhan
wars.outcome: Ottoman victory: the dynasty 'lasted for a first time until 1390, when Bayezid I overran the region'; Ottoman rule to 1402.
wars.note: No campaign dates beyond the year are given, so no contest is coded.

wars.name: Mehmed I's annexation of Saruhan
wars.outcome: Ottoman victory: Mehmed I killed Hızır, the last Saruhan ruler, and made the beylik an Ottoman province (1412 on the Sarukhanids page; 1410 on the Manisa page).
wars.note: The span 1410-1412 covers the two pages' dates; no fighting is described on either.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for the Aegean beylik; its limits against Aydin, Karasi and Germiyan are approximate throughout.

notes: Row identity: Wikidata Q1968654 is shared with the Cliopatria row 'Han' (-404..-203, the Warring States state of Han in China); the two are different states. The id is probably Cliopatria's error (the Sarukhanids article is the Wikipedia title kept here), so this dossier is a separate state and the wikidata field is Cliopatria's value as given; the gazetteer or link agent should check the id. Start 1313 (Manisa taken) against 'about 1300' on the Sarukhanids page and the beyliks table (1300-1410); end 1412 against 1410 (Manisa page, beyliks table) and Cliopatria's 1414. The 1390-1402 Ottoman interval and the 1402 restoration are absent from Cliopatria; the Ottoman dossier (me-10) should mirror the gains of 1390 and 1412 and the loss of 1402. The page says the Saruhanids 'regularly battled with the fleets of the Republic of Genoa and the Dukes of Naxos' (undated; no war coded). Not covered by any page opened: relations with Aydin and Karasi, the Ilkhanate, Phocaea (Foça), the 1344 Smyrna crusade, Timur's role in 1402.
